task1.title: Destination of UK graduates and postgraduates (excluding full-time work), 2008
task1.prompt: The charts below show what UK graduate and postgraduate students who did not go into full-time work did after leaving college in 2008.

chartDesc.title: Destination of UK graduates (excluding full-time work) 2008 / Destination of UK postgraduates (excluding full-time work) 2008
chartDesc.overview: For both graduates and postgraduates not in full-time work in 2008, further study was the most common destination, while voluntary work was significantly the least popular.
keyFeatures: For graduates, further study had the highest number at 29,665, followed by part-time work (17,735) and unemployment (16,235), with voluntary work at the lowest (3,500).
For postgraduates, further study was also highest (2,725), closely followed by part-time work (2,535), while voluntary work was the lowest (345).

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
